messages:
jiayi: quick idea — instead of reuploading full safetensors checkpoint for tiny model deltas, what if we support an append-only sparse-patch layer that references base shards and stores only changed slices?

matt: hm, like a sidecar delta file per shard? curious about atomicity and lookup perf. :thinking:

aline: will need clear guarantees for ordering and fallback. if a delta is missing we must not return corrupt params. what about checksums/versions?

tomas: +1 for sidecar. my sketch: keep base safetensors file immutable. deltas are small binary segments with header: `base-shard-id`, `byte-range`, `format-v`, `sha256`. apply logic: read base ranges, then overlay delta ranges at serve time.

jiayi: exactly — overlay at read-time, not write-time. we can stream-merge: read base chunk then apply any small in-memory patches from delta. avoids full rewrite but keeps mmap-friendly base.

matt: perf questions: lots of small deltas could blow up random IO. we should group deltas into a compact index or pack small deltas into page-aligned blobs. maybe require delta segments be page-aligned to reduce extra reads.

aline: also need a protocol for evicting/compacting deltas. if too many delta layers stack, degrade. compaction job could produce a new base shard and retire applied deltas.

tomas: agree. compaction policy: threshold by count or total delta bytes. compaction should produce a new base and write atomic rename + tombstone older deltas. ops-bot can handle GC tasks.

ops-bot: noted — can add a compaction worker. propose safe GC window = 24h by default; support manual trigger. will emit events to `eng-ml` when compaction starts/finishes.

devx: SDK impact: need read API that accepts `base_shard_path` + zero-or-more `delta_paths`. Example: `weights.load_shard(base, deltas=[...], verify=true)`. We should keep default to `deltas=[]` for backwards compatibility.

matt: verification: require delta header has `parent-hash` to prevent misapplied patches. simple check: `if parent != sha256(base-header) -> reject`. then `sha256` of merged segment must match final manifest if present.

jiayi: proposal: delta file format minimal spec in 1 paragraph: header (utf8 json) + sequence of records {offset:uint64, len:uint32, data}, each record aligned to 4k. header fields: base_shard_id, base_version, parent_hash, format_version, created_by, crc32 for quick check. keep it intentionally simple.

aline: add a safety fallback: if overlay fails, return error and trigger fallback route to older model-version or slower full-load path. must be plumbed into router's graceful-degradation.

devx: rollout plan: start as opt-in behind `ENABLE_DELTA_LOADS` flag, initially only for small experimental models, monitor error rate & latency. dashboard: delta hit rate, compaction lag, failed overlays.

matt: security: ensure deltas are signed or authenticated for private deployments. `ops-bot` can require KMS-signed manifests when deployed in Private mode.

ops-bot: will add signature enforcement toggle.

jiayi: ok i'll draft RFC with sample binary layout and a toy loader patch. will include microbench numbers for overlay cost vs full rewrite. planning to open PR next week. :shipit:

matt: thanks — pls include upgrade/rollback story and compaction invariants.

aline: and UX for devs: tooling to create deltas from diffs between model checkpoints. a tiny CLI `rw-delta create base.safetensors updated.safetensors -o delta.bin`.

jiayi: good call — will prototype CLI too.
